income.purpose: For the money coming in each day. Made for counter sales: one row per day of the month.
income.step1: Type what you took in on each day.
income.step2: The Total adds itself up, no formulas.

expense.purpose: For your day-to-day spending. Each row carries a date, a description with a category, and the amount.
expense.step1: Pick the date from the calendar.
expense.step2: Tap the tag and choose a category.
expense.step3: Enter the amount: it counts against “Out”.

ledger.purpose: Your bank account, movement by movement. Starts from the month's balance and keeps deposits and expenses apart.
ledger.step2: Record each deposit and each expense.

blank.purpose: An empty table for whatever you need: text, money or date columns, as many as you like.
blank.step1: Name the table and its columns.
blank.step2: Add whatever extra columns you need.
blank.step3: Fill the rows; the total works itself out.
